description: This Java class 'CobHelper' provides utility methods for handling 'Cash on Books' (COB) related operations within the Fineract integration tests. It includes methods for retrieving COB partitions, fast forwarding the last COB date of a loan, and reprocessing loans, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: CobHelper
classes.description: Utility class for handling COB (Cash on Books) related operations in Fineract integration tests, such as retrieving partitions and updating loan COB dates.

methods.name: getCobPartitions
methods.description: Retrieves COB partition information from the server given a partition size and expected response format. Marked as deprecated for removal.

methods.name: fastForwardLoansLastCOBDate
methods.description: Updates the last COB date of a specified loan to a given date to simulate time passage or test date-dependent functionality.

methods.name: reprocessLoan
methods.description: Triggers reprocessing of a loan in the system, typically to apply new COB data or state changes.
